handoff_summary.completed: Verified memory.py exists at repo root with all commands (init, add, search, delete, list, stats) and helper functions (_init_db, _open_db, _serialize_vec, _embed). Syntax check passes. Module imports cleanly inside managed venv. Functional smoke test confirms insert, search, and stats work end-to-end. Bootstrap correctly short-circuits when already inside the venv.
handoff_summary.remaining: None. Parent bead B-c780e85e can be retried via the review agent.
handoff_summary.risks: _MODEL_SHA256 is set to None (verification skipped until hash is computed at first real model download). This is a known pending decision in spec-a536cb5e and does not affect test execution since _embed is mocked in all tests.
handoff_summary.next_action: Retry parent bead B-c780e85e with the review agent. All expected files now exist at the repo root: memory.py implements both spec-a536cb5e and spec-9f1b7155.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No new conflicts introduced. memory.py is the sole owner of its file scope. Downstream tester and review agents can proceed in parallel since memory.py is stable.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Bootstrap guard uses `str(_VENV) in sys.prefix` so module can be imported via importlib from within the venv without triggering os.execv. _serialize_vec uses struct.pack which produces identical bytes to sqlite_vec.serialize_float32 (verified). Distance metric is L2 Euclidean (range 0-2 for normalised vectors), documented in _init_db docstring. Source filtering is post-ANN (post-filter) per spec guidance since sqlite-vec 0.1.x does not support pre-filter constraints in vec0.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: test_commands.py covers all four commands (search, delete, list, stats) including edge cases: threshold filtering, source filtering, nonexistent DB (exit 0 vs exit 1), JSON output, limit=0 for unlimited list, newest-first ordering.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: _MODEL_SHA256 is None; SHA256 verification is skipped until the implementing operator computes the hash of the downloaded model.onnx. Compute with: curl -L https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx -o model.onnx && sha256sum model.onnx

conflict_risks: No new conflicts introduced. memory.py is the sole owner of its file scope. Downstream tester and review agents can proceed in parallel since memory.py is stable.

guardrails.template_text:
# Developer Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Implement only the assigned bead inside the existing architecture and file scope.

Allowed actions:
- Modify code, configuration, or local docs required to complete the assigned bead.
- Create sub-beads for discovered follow-up work that should be handled separately.
- Verify your `Python` changes compile and import correctly with a quick syntax check: `python -m py_compile`.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `pytest` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
